sections.title: 中考精准练 (一)
raw_text: Have you heard of wallball?
Wallball is a simple sport to play.
You only need a ball 1. ________ a wall, so you can play anywhere at any time.
As the name shows, wallball is about hitting a small ball against a wall.
To do this, keep your hand open and use your palm to hit it.
Usually, gloves 2. ________ (need), but you can choose not to wear them.
You can use either of your 3. ________ (hand) to hit the ball.
Two players take turns to hit the ball.
One player bounces the ball once and hits it against the wall.
Then 4. ________ other player hits it back to the wall.
If a player fails to hit the ball to the wall before it bounces twice, this player will lose one point.
The player that reaches 11, 15 or 21 points first wins the game.
Before starting, make sure how many points you want 5. ________ (reach).
If you win two games first, you'll win the match.
But if the game score is 1-1, one more game is often played.
"Last month, we 6. ________ (have) several matches against other schools.
Every match was 7. ________ (exciting) than I thought.

It makes 8. ________ (I) crazy," said James, a wallball lover from the UK.

filled_text: Have you heard of wallball?
Wallball is a simple sport to play.
You only need a ball and a wall, so you can play anywhere at any time.
As the name shows, wallball is about hitting a small ball against a wall.
To do this, keep your hand open and use your palm to hit it.
Usually, gloves are needed, but you can choose not to wear them.
You can use either of your hands to hit the ball.
Two players take turns to hit the ball.
One player bounces the ball once and hits it against the wall.
Then the other player hits it back to the wall.
If a player fails to hit the ball to the wall before it bounces twice, this player will lose one point.
The player that reaches 11, 15 or 21 points first wins the game.
Before starting, make sure how many points you want to reach.
If you win two games first, you'll win the match.
But if the game score is 1-1, one more game is often played.
"Last month, we had several matches against other schools.
Every match was more exciting than I thought.
I can't wait for the next year's match!
It makes me crazy," said James, a wallball lover from the UK.
More and more people today become interested in wallball.
Some clubs have built colorful courts.
However, you can certainly set up your own court at home.
If you like wallball, get started.
filled_text_cn: 你听说过墙球吗？
墙球是一项简单的运动。
你只需要一个球和一面墙，所以你可以在任何时间任何地点玩。
正如名字所示，墙球就是把一个小球打向墙壁。
要做到这一点，保持你的手掌张开并用手掌去击打它。
通常，手套是必需的，但你可以选择不戴。
你可以用两只手中的任何一只来击球。
两名球员轮流击球。
一名球员将球弹起一次并将其打向墙上。
然后另一个球员把球打回了墙上。
如果一名球员在球弹起两次之前未能将球打到墙上，这名球员将失一分。
首先达到11、15或21分的球员赢得比赛。
在开始之前，确定你想达到多少分。
如果你先赢得两局，你就会赢得比赛。
但如果比分是1-1，通常会再进行一场比赛。
“上个月，我们和其他学校进行了几场比赛。
每场比赛都比我想象的更精彩。
我等不及明年的比赛了！
这让我疯狂，”来自英国的墙球爱好者詹姆斯说。
现在越来越多的人对墙球感兴趣。
一些俱乐部已经建造了色彩斑斓的球场。
然而，你当然可以在家里建立自己的球场。
如果你喜欢墙球，那就开始吧。

questions.explanation: 前后两者是并列关系，表示“一个球和一面墙”，用and连接。
questions.rule_summary: 连接并列成分表顺承时用and。

questions.explanation: 主语“gloves”是动作的承受者，时态是一般现在时，所以用一般现在时的被动语态(are/is done)。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者时需用被动语态。

questions.explanation: 根据“either of your...”，either of后接可数名词复数形式，故填hands。
questions.rule_summary: either of后接可数名词复数形式。

questions.explanation: 此处是固定搭配 One...the other...结构，意为“一个……另一个……”，故填the。
questions.rule_summary: One...the other...结构中the other表示两者中的另一个。

questions.explanation: want to do是固定搭配，意为“想要做某事”，故填to reach。
questions.rule_summary: want后常接动词不定式作宾语。

questions.explanation: 根据句中的时间标志词“Last month”可知，句子应用一般过去时，动词用过去式had。
questions.rule_summary: 带有过去时间状语的句子应用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 根据句中的“than”可知，此处应使用形容词的比较级，exciting的比较级为more exciting。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现than时，形容词应用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 此处位于动词makes之后，作宾语，应用人称代词宾格形式me。
questions.rule_summary: 动词或介词后的人称代词应用宾格形式。

questions.explanation: become interested in是固定短语，意为“对……产生兴趣”，故填in。
questions.rule_summary: interest相关形容词常与介词in搭配构成固定短语。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词短语set up，应用副词形式certainly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或其他副词。

sections.title: 中考精准练 (二)
raw_text: In China, people often talk about "Shuxiang", especially during the Spring Festival.
Images of the 12 Chinese "Shuxiang" animals are fun for everyone.
The rabbit is in the 11. ________ (four) place.
The rabbit is a symbol of kindness and a love of beauty in Chinese culture.
People born in the Year of Rabbit are usually 12. ________ (peace) and quick-minded.
Although they are sometimes shy, they have a strong mind and will try their best 13. ________ (make) their dreams come true.
It is said that rabbit people are much 14. ________ (wise) than other people and love taking part in artistic activities.
2023 is a "rabbit year".
Rabbits become more popular.
You can see 15. ________ (they) across the world.
As a cultural image, the rabbit has been in different forms of art, including 16. ________ (stamp), colourful lights and so on.
Through the rabbit, people from other countries can get a closer look into Chinese culture.
In January, 2023, an exhibition about rabbits 17. ________ (hold) in the US.
filled_text: In China, people often talk about "Shuxiang", especially during the Spring Festival.
Images of the 12 Chinese "Shuxiang" animals are fun for everyone.
The rabbit is in the fourth place.
The rabbit is a symbol of kindness and a love of beauty in Chinese culture.
People born in the Year of Rabbit are usually peaceful and quick-minded.
Although they are sometimes shy, they have a strong mind and will try their best to make their dreams come true.
It is said that rabbit people are much wiser than other people and love taking part in artistic activities.
2023 is a "rabbit year".
Rabbits become more popular.
You can see them across the world.
As a cultural image, the rabbit has been in different forms of art, including stamps, colourful lights and so on.
Through the rabbit, people from other countries can get a closer look into Chinese culture.
In January, 2023, an exhibition about rabbits was held in the US.
filled_text_cn: 在中国，人们经常谈论“书香”，特别是在春节期间。
12种中国“书香”动物的形象对每个人来说都很有趣。
兔子排在第四位。
在中国文化中，兔子是善良和热爱美的象征。
兔年出生的人通常很温和、思维敏捷。
虽然他们有时会害羞，但他们意志坚定，会尽最大努力实现梦想。
据说兔年出生的人比其他人更聪明，喜欢参加艺术活动。
兔子变得更受欢迎了。
你可以在世界各地看到它们。
作为一个文化形象，兔子已经出现在各种艺术形式中，包括邮票、彩灯等。
通过兔子，来自其他国家的人们可以更近距离地了解中国文化。
2023年1月，美国举办了一场关于兔子的展览。

questions.explanation: 句意：兔子在第四名。根据the可知，此空应填序数词表示顺序，故填fourth。
questions.rule_summary: 基数词前有定冠词 the 时，通常要变为序数词表示顺序。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词派生名词/名词派生形容词
questions.explanation: 句意：兔年出生的人通常都很平和，思维敏捷。此空与 quick-minded 构成并列关系，作表语应填形容词 peaceful“平和的”，故填 peaceful。
questions.rule_summary: 名词后加 -ful 可以构成本义的形容词，在句中作表语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然他们有时会害羞，但他们有一个坚强的头脑，会尽他们最大的努力使他们的梦想成真。try one's best to do sth“尽某人最大努力去做某事”，此空应填动词不定式，故填 to make。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 try one's best to do sth 表示“尽力做某事”。

questions.explanation: 句意：据说兔子人比其他人聪明，喜欢参加艺术活动。根据than可知，此空应填比较级，故填 wiser。
questions.rule_summary: 句子中出现 than 时，形容词或副词通常要用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：你可以在世界各地看到它们。see是动词，后接人称代词宾格作宾语，them是宾格，故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 动词和介词后面的人称代词要用宾格形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：作为一种文化形象，兔子已经出现在不同的艺术形式中，包括邮票、彩灯等。此空与 colourful lights 构成并列关系，所以此空应填复数形式，故填 stamps。
questions.rule_summary: 当列举多个并列的名词时，可数名词通常用复数形式表示泛指。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：2023年1月，美国举办了一个关于兔子的展览。主语 an exhibition 与动词 hold 之间是被动关系，结合“In January, 2023”可知，此处用一般过去时被动语态，主语是单数形式，助动词用 was，故填 was held。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者且发生在过去时，用一般过去时的被动语态 (was/were done)。

sections.title: 中考精准练 (三)
raw_text: It is believed that the earliest chopsticks were developed over 5,000 years ago in China.
In the Spring and Autumn Period, metal chopsticks appeared.
Today 18. ________ (us) have chopsticks made of different materials.
In ancient times, the rich 19. ________ (usual) used hard green stone or gold chopsticks for showing their wealth.

It was said that silver chopsticks would turn black if they touched poisoned food (but we know it was wrong today), so in history many kings used them 20. ________ (see) whether the food was bad for them or not.
In China, chopsticks 21. ________ (give) to a daughter when she marries to hope that they will have a child very soon, because the word in Chinese is pronounced like "quick child".
People often believe chopsticks mean good luck.
So on the 22. ________ (one) day of a new year, many families will put new chopsticks on the table at dinner, wishing good luck.
It's believed that using chopsticks at dinner is very 23. ________ (help) to make your fingers do everything freely.
It can improve memory, too.
Now many westerners put the knives and forks beside their 24. ________ (bowl) and dishes but choose chopsticks in China.
filled_text: It is believed that the earliest chopsticks were developed over 5,000 years ago in China.
In the Spring and Autumn Period, metal chopsticks appeared.
Today we have chopsticks made of different materials.
In ancient times, the rich usually used hard green stone or gold chopsticks for showing their wealth.
It was said that silver chopsticks would turn black if they touched poisoned food (but we know it was wrong today), so in history many kings used them to see whether the food was bad for them or not.
In China, chopsticks are given to a daughter when she marries to hope that they will have a child very soon, because the word in Chinese is pronounced like "quick child".
People often believe chopsticks mean good luck.
So on the first day of a new year, many families will put new chopsticks on the table at dinner, wishing good luck.
It's believed that using chopsticks at dinner is very helpful to make your fingers do everything freely.
It can improve memory, too.
Now many westerners put the knives and forks beside their bowls and dishes but choose chopsticks in China.
filled_text_cn: 据信，最早的筷子是在5000多年前在中国发展起来的。
在春秋时期，金属筷子出现了。
今天我们有不同材质的筷子。
在古代，富人通常用坚硬的绿色石头或金筷子来显示他们的财富。
据说银筷子如果碰到有毒的食物就会变黑（但今天我们知道这是不对的），所以在历史上许多国王用它们来判断食物是否对他们有害。
在中国，当女儿结婚时，会给她一双筷子，希望他们很快能有个孩子，因为这个词在中文里的发音类似于“快子”。
人们通常认为筷子意味着好运。
所以在新年的第一天，许多家庭会在用餐时把新的筷子放在桌子上，希望交好运。
人们认为，在用餐时使用筷子非常有助于让你的手指自由地做任何事情。
它也能改善记忆力。
现在许多西方人把刀叉放在碗和盘子旁边，而在中国却选择筷子。

questions.explanation: 此空在句中作主语，应填人称代词主格形式，us的主格是we。
questions.rule_summary: 代词在句首作主语时用主格形式。

questions.explanation: 此句不缺少主干成分，需填入副词作状语修饰动词used，usual的副词形式是usually。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词变副词通常加 -ly，在句中作状语修饰动词。

questions.explanation: 句意：许多国王用它们来判断食物是否对他们有害。use sth. to do sth. 意为“用某物做某事”，此处用动词不定式作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: 表示目的时常用动词不定式 (to do)。

questions.explanation: 主语 chopsticks 与动词 give 之间是被动关系，且陈述客观事实用一般现在时，主语 chopsticks 是复数，故助动词用 are，填 are given。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者时，谓语动词用“be + done”构成的被动语态。

questions.explanation: 根据“on the ... day of a new year”可知，此处指在新年的“第一”天，空前有the，应用序数词 first。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“第几”时，基数词需变为对应的序数词，前面常加定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: is后接形容词作表语，根据句意可知使用筷子用餐是有帮助的，help对应的形容词是 helpful。
questions.rule_summary: 系动词（如 be）后面常接形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 根据并列的名词“dishes”可知，此处也应用可数名词的复数形式 bowls 与之对应。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词表泛指或复数概念时，需变为复数形式。

questions.explanation: 根据固定搭配“in China（在中国）”，应填入介词 in。
questions.rule_summary: 表示在某国、某城市等较大的地方时，通常用介词 in。

questions.explanation: 前半句说西方人把刀叉放在碗盘旁，后半句说在中国选择筷子，前后构成转折关系，故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 表示意思上的转折时，使用并列连词 but。

questions.explanation: 修饰空后的名词 bowls and dishes，需用形容词性物主代词 their（他们的）。
questions.rule_summary: 名词前修饰所属关系时，用形容词性物主代词。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (一)
raw_text: Qi Baishi is a world-famous art master in China.
He was born in 1. ________ poor family from Xiangtan, Hunan Province.
He was at school for less than a year because 2. ________ illnesses.
One day, he found a Chinese painting guide book—Jieziyuan Huapu.
The book inspired his interest in painting 3. ________ (picture).
He decided 4. ________ (learn) by himself and later became a master of art through his hard work.
In 1902, he 5. ________ (start) to travel around China.
He visited famous places, met many people and saw different kinds of art pieces.
These experiences helped him become one of the 6. ________ (good) artists of all time.
7. ________ (He) paintings are generally about the small things of the world, such as fish, shrimps and frogs.
Mouse and Cat with Lamp is one of them.
In the picture, a mouse is standing on the top of a long pole.
Under the pole is a cat.
They are so lively 8. ________ it looks like they would jump out of the paper to fight.
All the works 9. ________ (create) by Qi Baishi in a fresh way, which expressed his love for nature and life.
His talents and skills amazed the whole world a lot.
He is 10. ________ (real) a master of art and the pride of Hunan.
filled_text: Qi Baishi is a world-famous art master in China.
He was born in a poor family from Xiangtan, Hunan Province.
He was at school for less than a year because of illnesses.
One day, he found a Chinese painting guide book—Jieziyuan Huapu.
The book inspired his interest in painting pictures.
He decided to learn by himself and later became a master of art through his hard work.
In 1902, he started to travel around China.
He visited famous places, met many people and saw different kinds of art pieces.
These experiences helped him become one of the best artists of all time.
His paintings are generally about the small things of the world, such as fish, shrimps and frogs.
Mouse and Cat with Lamp is one of them.
In the picture, a mouse is standing on the top of a long pole.
Under the pole is a cat.
They are so lively that it looks like they would jump out of the paper to fight.
All the works were created by Qi Baishi in a fresh way, which expressed his love for nature and life.
His talents and skills amazed the whole world a lot.
He is really a master of art and the pride of Hunan.
filled_text_cn: 齐白石是中国世界著名的艺术大师。
他出生在湖南湘潭的一个贫困家庭。
因为生病，他在学校待了不到一年。
有一天，他发现了一本中国画导读本——《芥子园画谱》。
这本书激发了他对绘画图片的兴趣。
他决定自学，后来通过他的努力成为了一名艺术大师。
1902年，他开始周游中国。
他参观了著名的地方，遇到了许多人，并看到了各种各样的艺术品。
这些经历帮助他成为有史以来最好的艺术家之一。
他的画一般都是关于世界上的小事物，比如鱼、虾和青蛙。
《灯鼠图》就是其中之一。
在画中，一只老鼠正站在一根长竿的顶端。
竿子下面是一只猫。
它们是如此逼真，看起来它们会跳出纸来打架。
所有的作品都是齐白石以新鲜的方式创作的，表达了他对自然和生命的热爱。
他的天赋和技巧使整个世界惊叹不已。
他真是艺术大师，湖南的骄傲。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一个贫穷的家庭”，poor以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。故填a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，辅音音素前用不定冠词a。

questions.explanation: because of意为“因为”，后接名词短语illnesses作宾语。故填of。
questions.rule_summary: because of后接名词或短语表示原因。

questions.explanation: 此处表示泛指绘画的图片，需用可数名词复数形式pictures。故填pictures。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指类别或无限定词修饰时，可数名词常使用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: decide to do sth.为固定搭配，意为“决定做某事”。故填to learn。
questions.rule_summary: decide后常接动词不定式作宾语。

questions.explanation: 根据时间状语“In 1902”可知，句子描述过去发生的动作，应用一般过去时，动词用过去式started。故填started。
questions.rule_summary: 根据句中的过去时间状语，谓语动词用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 名词复数表示“最……的……之一”。good的最高级是best。故填best。
questions.rule_summary: “one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词”表示最……之一。

questions.explanation: 修饰空后的名词“paintings”，应用形容词性物主代词His“他的”，位于句首首字母需大写。故填His。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时用形容词性物主代词。

questions.explanation: 根据“so lively...it looks like...”可知，此处考查so...that引导的结果状语从句，意为“如此……以至于……”。故填that。
questions.rule_summary: so...that结构中，so后接形容词或副词，that引导结果状语从句。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 主语“All the works”与谓语动词create之间是被动关系，且结合后文“expressed”可知应用一般过去时的被动语态（was/were done），主语是复数，be动词用were。故填were created。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，根据时态使用相应的被动语态(be done)。

questions.explanation: 修饰系动词is后面的表语成分（a master of art），应用副词really作状语。故填really。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰形容词、动词或整个句子。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (二)
raw_text: Did ancient people plant trees?
11. ________ they didn't have a special day to plant trees like Tree-Planting Day, the tradition of planting trees has been there for a long time.
Back then, it was always 12. ________ (rain) around the Tomb-Sweeping Day in spring.
The trees that were planted around this time had better conditions to grow than usual, so people formed the custom of planting trees around the Tomb-Sweeping Day.
There were many kinds of trees.
However, mulberry trees and fruit trees were the 13. ________ (popular) of all.
To feed the silkworms, more mulberry leaves 14. ________ (need).
Silk came from the silkworms, and then it was made into silk clothes and traded between the East and the West of the world.
Among the ancient people who suggested 15. ________ (get) trees to offer food and clothes, there was a man whose name is well-known, Mencius.
Dong Feng, a famous doctor in the Three Kingdom Period, saved many 16. ________ (patient) lives for free.
He only asked them to plant apricot trees on a hill.
Gradually, a forest of apricot trees grew on 17. ________ hill.
That's why we now praise a doctor who has excellent skills with the words "warmth in an apricot forest".
Each dynasty has different tree planting projects.
Li Shimin, Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty, 18. ________ (personal) planted a ginkgo tree in a temple in Chang' an.
1,400 years later, the ginkgo tree is still growing.

filled_text: Did ancient people plant trees?
Although they didn't have a special day to plant trees like Tree-Planting Day, the tradition of planting trees has been there for a long time.
Back then, it was always rainy around the Tomb-Sweeping Day in spring.
The trees that were planted around this time had better conditions to grow than usual, so people formed the custom of planting trees around the Tomb-Sweeping Day.
There were many kinds of trees.
However, mulberry trees and fruit trees were the most popular of all.
To feed the silkworms, more mulberry leaves were needed.
Silk came from the silkworms, and then it was made into silk clothes and traded between the East and the West of the world.

Dong Feng, a famous doctor in the Three Kingdom Period, saved many patients' lives for free.
He only asked them to plant apricot trees on a hill.
Gradually, a forest of apricot trees grew on the hill.
That's why we now praise a doctor who has excellent skills with the words "warmth in an apricot forest".
Each dynasty has different tree planting projects.
Li Shimin, Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty, personally planted a ginkgo tree in a temple in Chang' an.

filled_text_cn: 古代人种树吗？
尽管他们没有像植树节这样的特殊植树日，但植树的传统已经存在很长时间了。
那时，春天的清明节前后总是下雨。
在这个时间左右种下的树比平时有更好的生长条件，所以人们形成了在清明节前后种树的习俗。
树的种类很多。
然而，桑树和果树是最受欢迎的。
为了喂蚕，需要更多的桑叶。
丝绸来自蚕，然后被制成丝绸衣服，并在东西方世界之间进行贸易。
在古代建议用树来提供食物和衣服的人中，有一个名字很有名的人，他就是孟子。
三国时期的名医董奉免费挽救了许多病人的生命。
他只要求他们在山上种杏树。
渐渐地，山上长出了一片杏树林。
这就是为什么我们现在用“杏林春暖”来赞美医术高明的医生。
每个朝代都有不同的植树项目。
唐太宗李世民亲自在长安的一座寺庙里种了一棵银杏树。
1400年后，这棵银杏树仍在生长。
到目前为止，这座寺庙已经成为游客的热门景点。
那么，在明年的植树节，你想种一棵带着你愿望的树吗？

questions.explanation: 根据句意“尽管他们没有像植树节这样的特殊植树日，但植树的传统已经存在很长时间了”可知，前后句构成让步关系，应用Although/Though引导让步状语从句。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“虽然，尽管”时，用Although或Though引导让步状语从句，不能与but连用。

questions.explanation: 空格所填词在句中作表语，描述天气特征，应该用形容词形式 rainy（多雨的）。
questions.rule_summary: 动词或名词作表语时，常需转换成对应的形容词形式。

questions.explanation: 根据句中“of all（在所有之中）”可知，此处表示三者或三者以上范围的比较，应用最高级；空前已有定冠词 the，因此只需填 most popular。
questions.rule_summary: 表示在一定范围内“最……”时，多音节形容词前加 most 构成最高级。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 主语“more mulberry leaves”与动词 need 之间是被动关系（桑叶被需要），且文章讲述过去的事情应用一般过去时，复数主语的被动语态结构为 were + done。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，根据时态使用相应的被动语态（be + done）。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 suggest doing sth.（建议做某事），动词 suggest 后接动名词作宾语。
questions.rule_summary: suggest 后面常接动名词（doing）作宾语，表示建议做某事。

questions.explanation: 根据“many... lives”可知，此处修饰 lives 应用名词所有格；结合语境“许多病人的生命”，patient 需先变为复数 patients，再加撇构成复数所有格 patients'。
questions.rule_summary: 当修饰后面的名词表示所属关系时，复数名词以s结尾的加所有格符号'（s'）。

questions.explanation: 此处特指前文提到的那座山（种杏树的那座山），应用定冠词 the 表特指。
questions.rule_summary: 上文已经提到过的人或物，再次提到时用定冠词 the 进行特指。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词 planted（种植），应用副词形式 personally（亲自）。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子，形容词词尾加 -ly 通常变副词。

questions.explanation: 句中有时间标志词“So far（到目前为止）”，这是现在完成时的典型标志；主语 the temple 是单数，助动词用 has，故填 has become。
questions.rule_summary: 看到 So far、since 等标志词时，主句通常用现在完成时（have/has done）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 空格后的“the Tree-Planting Day next year”指具体的某一节日或天，前面应用介词 on。
questions.rule_summary: 在具体的某一天、节日当天或特定的早中晚前，通常使用介词 on。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (三)

filled_text: Dear Millie,
You asked me about the Dragon Boat Festival. Now let me tell you something about it.
The Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional Chinese festival we Chinese have celebrated for over 2,000 years.
It's one of the three most important lunar festivals in China, along with the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival.
The Dragon Boat Festival takes place on the tenth of June this year.
Over the years, many stories have been told about the beginning of this festival.
Among them, the most famous one is about Qu Yuan, a well-known scholar in ancient China.
He not only wrote good poems but also gave suggestions to the king.
The king didn't like him though/although he devoted himself to his country.
This great person drowned himself in the Miluo River on the 5th day of the 5th Chinese lunar month because his Chu State fell to Qin State.
Local people tried to save him or find his body, but they didn't find him successfully.
Qu Yuan was later considered as a national hero.
To remember him, every fifth day of the fifth lunar month, people beat drums and go boat racing on the river as they once did to keep fish away from his body.
Dragon boat racing is one of the most important customs Chinese people practice to celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival.
This activity is held widely in China's southern and southeastern areas where there are lots of rivers and lakes.
Lots of love,
Wendy
filled_text_cn: 亲爱的米莉：
你向我询问关于端午节的事。现在让我来告诉你一些关于它的事情。
端午节是我们中国人庆祝了两千多年的传统节日。
它是中国三个最重要的阴历节日之一，与春节和中秋节并列。
今年的端午节在六月十日。
多年来，有许多关于这个节日开端的传说。
其中，最著名的一个是关于中国古代著名学者屈原的。
他不仅写了好诗，还向国王提出了建议。
尽管他忠于国家，但国王并不喜欢他。
由于他的楚国被秦国攻陷，这位伟人于农历五月初五在汨罗江自沉殉国。
当地人们试图营救他或寻找他的遗体，但他们并没有成功找到他。
屈原后来被认为是一位民族英雄。
为了纪念他，每年农历五月初五，人们会在河上敲鼓赛龙舟，就像他们曾经做的那样，以此来驱赶鱼类，不让它们靠近他的身体。
赛龙舟是中国人庆祝端午节最重要的习俗之一。
这项活动在中国南部和东南部河流湖泊众多的地区广泛举行。
爱你的，
温迪

questions.explanation: 根据时间状语“for over 2,000 years”可知句子应用现在完成时（have/has done），主语为“we”，助动词用have。故填have celebrated。
questions.rule_summary: for+时间段常与现在完成时连用。

questions.explanation: 句意：端午节在今年的六月十日。此处表示具体日期，在定冠词the之后应用基数词ten的序数词tenth。
questions.rule_summary: 表示日期或顺序时使用序数词，前有the修饰。

questions.explanation: 空前有定冠词“the”，空后有介词“of”，构成了“the... of...”结构，因此需要填入动词begin的名词形式beginning。
questions.rule_summary: the + 名词 + of结构中应用名词形式。

questions.explanation: 根据范围短语“Among them”以及句意可知，此处表示“其中最著名的一个”，应用形容词famous的最高级形式，且最高级前必须加定冠词the。
questions.rule_summary: 在三者或三者以上范围（among them）中进行比较用最高级，前加the。

questions.explanation: 此空位于动词“gave”后面作宾语，应用suggest的名词形式suggestion；此处泛指提出建议，应用其复数形式suggestions。
questions.rule_summary: 动词后接名词作宾语，可数名词常以复数形式表示泛指。

questions.explanation: 句意：尽管他忠于祖国，但国王不喜欢他。“he devoted himself to his country”与“The king didn't like him”之间存在逻辑上的让步关系，应用though/although引导让步状语从句。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“虽然、尽管”时用though或although引导让步状语从句。

questions.explanation: 句意：当地人试图救他，但没有成功找到他。此空用来修饰动词“find”，应用success的副词形式successfully。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词，说明动作执行的方式。

questions.explanation: 句意：屈原后来被认为是民族英雄。此处泛指“一个民族英雄”，“national”是以辅音音素开头的单词，因此应用不定冠词a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，在辅音音素前用不定冠词a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：人们在河上赛龙舟是为了让鱼远离他的身体。此处表示目的，作目的状语应用动词不定式（to do）。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式常用来在句中作目的状语，意为“为了……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：这项活动广泛地在中国的南部和东南部地区举行。主语“This activity”与动词“hold”之间是被动关系，且陈述的是客观事实，应用一般现在时的被动语态（is/am/are + done），主语为单数，be动词用is。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者且描述客观事实时，用一般现在时的被动语态。

filled_text_cn: 皮影戏是中国最古老的戏剧之一。
这是一种古老的讲故事和娱乐方式。
它用皮影木偶来表现移动的人和其他物体的印象。
它诞生于两千多年前的古代长安。
自从宋朝以来,皮影戏越来越流行了。
明朝期间,北京市有40~50个皮影戏团。
在那个时候,它给人们带来了现代电影和电视所能带来的快乐。
表演者一边唱一边控制影子工具。
戏剧通常是关于传统历史剧和寓言故事。

questions.explanation: 句意：皮影戏是中国最古老的戏剧之一。“one of the + 形容词最高级 + 名词复数”表示“最……之一”，固定句型，old 的最高级是 oldest。故填 oldest。
questions.rule_summary: one of the后接形容词最高级和名词复数，表示“最……之一”。

questions.explanation: 句意：这是一种古老的讲故事和娱乐方式。这里泛指一种古老形式，且 ancient 首字母发元音音素，所以用不定冠词 an。故填 an。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，元音音素前用 an。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：它用皮影木偶来表现移动的人和其他物体的印象。use sth. to do...“使用某物做……”，固定短语，所以空处用动词不定式。故填 to show。
questions.rule_summary: use sth. to do sth. 表示“使用某物去做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：它诞生于两千多年前的古代长安。主语 it 与 create 之间是动宾关系，且结合“more than 2,000 years ago”可知，此处用一般过去时的被动语态，结构是 was/were done，主语是 it，be 动词用 was，create 的过去分词是 created。故填 was created。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者且发生在过去时，用一般过去时的被动语态(was/were done)。

questions.explanation: 句意：自从宋朝以来，皮影戏越来越流行了。根据“since the Song Dynasty”可知，此处用现在完成时，结构为 have/has done，主语是单数名词，所以助动词用 has，后跟 become 的过去分词还是 become。故填 has become。
questions.rule_summary: since引导的时间状语从句或时间点常与现在完成时连用。

questions.explanation: 句意：明朝期间，北京市有40~50个皮影戏团。本句考查 there be 句型，表示“有……”。故填 there。
questions.rule_summary: There be 句型用于表达客观存在，意为“有……”。

questions.explanation: 句意：在那个时候，它给人们带来了现代电影和电视所能带来的快乐。空处在句中作 bring 的宾语，所以用 please 的名词形式 pleasure“快乐”，不可数名词。故填 pleasure。
questions.rule_summary: 动词或形容词可通过派生后缀转化为名词作宾语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：表演者一边唱一边控制影子工具。根据“Actors sing and control shadow tools...the same time.”及常识可知，皮影戏是唱与操控皮影同时进行的，at the same time“同时”。故填 at。
questions.rule_summary: at the same time 为固定介词短语，意为“同时”。

questions.explanation: 句意：戏剧通常是关于传统历史剧和寓言故事。空处和 historical 一起作定语修饰名词 dramas，所以用 tradition 的形容词 traditional“传统的”。故填 traditional。
questions.rule_summary: 名词作定语或转化为形容词修饰后面的名词。

questions.explanation: 句意：皮影戏既有趣又有丰富的文化内涵。根据“Shadow puppet... (play)”可知，此处指皮影戏，在句中作主语，且由 are 可知，此处用名词复数 plays。故填 plays。
questions.rule_summary: 主语为复数概念或谓语动词为 are 时，可数名词主语应用复数形式。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (五)
raw_text: What happens to the coins in Rome's Trevi Fountain?

filled_text: What happens to the coins in Rome's Trevi Fountain?
People from all over the world come to throw coins into the fountain, making a wish.
Few give their coins a second thought.
Well, the coins don't just sit there.
Instead, they are collected and given to a charity called Caritas.
Caritas uses the money to help people in need.
It runs a food bank, a soup kitchen and other different welfare projects.
In 2023, Caritas got over 1.4 million euros (10.92 million yuan) from the fountain and it expects to have gotten even more coins in 2024.
The process of collecting the coins is quite interesting.
Workers carefully balance on the edge of the fountain, using both long brooms and suction hoses to suck up the coins.
Once collected, the coins are dried, organized and counted by workers.
Up to four workers collect the coins from the fountain twice a week.
The fountain is also drained for cleaning twice a month.
Tourists are happy to hear that their coins will go to help others someday.
"I wanted to make a wish which is dear to my heart," said Yula Cole from Brazil after throwing in a coin.
"But I also know that this coin is not just staying there but will help needy people.
I made a wish but hopefully, this money will help other people's wishes, too."
filled_text_cn: 罗马的特莱维喷泉里的硬币发生了什么？
来自世界各地的人们来到喷泉里扔硬币，许个愿。
很少有人会对自己的硬币再三考虑。
嗯，硬币不会只是静静地躺在那里。
相反，它们被收集起来，捐赠给一个叫做Caritas的慈善机构。
Caritas使用这些钱来帮助有需要的人。
它经营着一家食物库、一间流动厨房和其他不同的福利项目。
2023年，Caritas从喷泉获得了140多万欧元（1092万元人民币），并预计在2024年能获得更多的硬币。
收集硬币的过程非常有趣。
工人们小心翼翼地站在喷泉边缘保持平衡，用长扫帚和吸水管吸起硬币。
硬币收集起来后，由工人进行干燥、整理和清点。
多达四名工人每周从喷泉收集两次硬币。
喷泉每月还排空清洗两次。
游客们听到自己的硬币有一天会用来帮助别人时都很高兴。
“我想许一个在我心中非常珍贵的愿望，”来自巴西的尤拉·科尔在投下一枚硬币后说道。
“但我也知道这枚硬币不会只是留在那里，而是会帮助有需要的人。
我许了个愿，但希望这笔钱也能帮助其他人实现愿望。”

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意：很少有人会对自己的硬币再三考虑。coins为名词，此处应用形容词性物主代词their修饰名词。故填their。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰空后名词用形容词性物主代词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：相反，有人把它们收集起来，捐赠到一个叫做Caritas的慈善机构。主语they指代前文提到了the coins与动词collect存在被动关系，根据“Well, the coins don't just sit there.”可知，此处应用一般现在时的被动语态，主语为they，be动词用are，collect的过去分词为collected。故填are collected。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者且表示客观事实时，用一般现在时被动语态 (am/is/are + done)。

questions.explanation: 句意：Caritas使用这些钱去帮助那些有需要的人。根据“(help) people in need”可知，帮助有需要的人是使用这些钱的目的，用动词不定式表目的。故填to help。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式可在句中作目的状语，意为“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 句意：它经营着一家食物库、一间流动厨房和其他不同的福利项目。kitchen为单数名词，且soup为辅音音素开头的单词，此处应用不定冠词a表泛指。故填a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，辅音音素前用a。

questions.explanation: 句意：2023年，Caritas从喷泉获得了140多万欧元（1092万元人民币），预计2024年能获得更多的硬币。even修饰比较级，many的比较级为more。故填more。
questions.rule_summary: even、much、far等词常修饰形容词或副词的比较级。

questions.explanation: 句意：工人们小心翼翼地站在喷泉边缘保持平衡，用长扫帚和吸水管吸起硬币。balance为动词，应用副词carefully修饰。故填carefully。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词，置于动词前后均可。

questions.explanation: 句意：工人们小心翼翼地站在喷泉边缘保持平衡，用长扫帚和吸水管吸起硬币。both...and...意为“……和……”。故填and。
questions.rule_summary: both...and...用于连接两个并列的成分。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：硬币收集起来后，由工人进行干燥、整理和清点。根据“are dried, organized and counted”可知，该句为一般现在时的被动语态，此处应用by表示“由，被”。故填by。
questions.rule_summary: 在被动语态中，动作的执行者通常由介词by引出。

questions.explanation: 句意：游客们听到自己的硬币有一天会用来帮助别人时都很高兴。根据“are happy”和“someday”可知that引导的宾语从句应用一般将来时，其谓语结构为：will+动词原形。故填will go。
questions.rule_summary: 根据从句中的时间状语（如someday）结合主句判断，应用一般将来时。

questions.explanation: 句意：我许了一个愿望，但希望这笔钱也能帮助其他人实现愿望。wishes为名词，此处应用people的名词所有格修饰名词wishes。故填people's。
questions.rule_summary: 名词修饰名词时，通常使用名词所有格形式（'s / s'）。

filled_text: Girl cuts for the gold
Do you like traditional Chinese paper-cutting?
Ding Xiang, a student at Nongsishi Middle School in Xinjiang, is really good at it.
At the Eighth National Excellent Talents Competition last month in Beijing, the 15-year-old girl got the gold award for her paper-cutting skills.
At the competition, Ding cut a piece: Millennium Dream.
The piece has two papers.
One shows an ancient cave painting and the other a Chinese-made spaceship.
Ding said she wanted to show three things with the piece: China's long history, China's rapid development, and her hope for the future of paper-cutting.
Ding began to learn paper-cutting in the first year of her middle school.
She started to become more and more interested in it.
The next year, she had more schoolwork than before, but she didn't give up.
"I always find time for practicing every day.
If I don't have time during the day, I must practice at night," Ding said.
"It was a very long and hard time, but I enjoyed myself."
All the hard work has paid off.
In two years, Ding's skills have improved a lot, and she has the gold award to prove it.
Ding said she has learned a lot from paper-cutting.
"I have learned to observe things carefully," Ding told Yili Daily.
"I have become more confident, too.
It is a great help in my studies.
Also, I have learned a lot of history from the art."
filled_text_cn: 女孩为金牌而剪
你喜欢中国传统剪纸吗？
丁香是新疆农四师中学的一名学生，她在这方面真的很擅长。
在上个月北京举办的第八届全国优秀特长生总决赛中，这个15岁的女孩获得了剪纸艺术金奖。
在比赛中，丁剪了一幅作品：《千年梦想》。
这部作品由两张纸组成。
一张展示了一幅古代岩画，另一张展示了一艘中国制造的飞船。
丁说，她想用这幅作品展示三件事：中国悠久的历史，中国的快速发展，以及她对剪纸未来的希望。
丁在中学一年级开始学习剪纸。
她开始对它越来越感兴趣。
第二年，她的功课比以前多了，但她没有放弃。
“我总是每天抽出时间练习。
如果白天没时间，我晚上也必须练习，”丁说。
“这是一段漫长而艰难的时光，但我很享受。”
所有的辛勤付出都得到了回报。
在两年的时间里，丁的技术进步了很多，她获得了金奖可以证明这一点。
丁说，她从剪纸中学到了很多。
“我已经学会了细心观察事物，”丁告诉《伊犁日报》。
“我也变得更自信了。
这对我的学习有很大帮助。
此外，我还从这门艺术中学到了很多历史。”

questions.explanation: 句意：在上个月北京举办的第八届全国优秀特长生总决赛中，这个15岁的女孩获得了剪纸艺术金奖。此处指第八届全国优秀特长生总决赛，应用序数词，开头字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 基数词转化为序数词表示顺序，注意首字母大写。

questions.explanation: 句意：这部作品由两张纸组成。此处特指前文提到的 Millennium Dream，用定冠词the，句首开头字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 特指上文提到的人或物时用定冠词the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：丁说，她想用这幅作品展示三件事：中国悠久的历史，中国的快速发展，以及她对剪纸未来的希望。want to do“想要做某事”，固定搭配。
questions.rule_summary: want 后面常接动词不定式作宾语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意：丁说，她想用这幅作品展示三件事：中国悠久的历史，中国的快速发展，以及她对剪纸未来的希望。空处与“China's long history”及“China's rapid development”并列，应用并列连词and。
questions.rule_summary: 并列成分之间表顺承和并列时用 and 连接。

questions.explanation: 句意：丁在中学一年级开始学习剪纸。由“in the first year of her middle school.”可知句子为一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。
questions.rule_summary: 根据句中过去时间状语或语境，确定使用一般过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：她开始对它越来越感兴趣。be interested in“对......感兴趣”，固定搭配。
questions.rule_summary: be interested in 表示“对……感兴趣”。

questions.explanation: 句意：第二年，她的功课比以前多了，但她没有放弃。由“than”可知为比较级。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现 than 时，形容词或副词通常用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：这是一段漫长而艰难的时光，但我很享受。enjoy oneself“尽情享受，感到快乐”，固定搭配，my 的反身代词为 myself。
questions.rule_summary: 主语和宾语为同一人时，动词后用反身代词。

questions.explanation: 句意：在两年的时间里，丁的技术进步了很多，她获得了金奖可以证明这一点。此处指丁香的剪纸技术，结合“have”可知应用名词复数。
questions.rule_summary: 句中谓语动词用 have 表明主语是复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：丁在接受《伊犁日报》采访时表示：“我已经学会了细心观察事物。”此处需要副词 carefully 修饰动词 observe，表示细心观察。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词，说明动作发生的方式或状态。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (七)
raw_text: The year 2024 celebrates the Year of the Dragon.
Among the 12 animals of the Chinese zodiac, the dragon is the only one that is not real.
61. ________ it looks scary, Chinese people respect it and even see 62. ________ (they) as the descendants of the dragon.
Wen Yiduo (1899-1946), a famous Chinese scholar and poet of his time, said that the image of a Chinese dragon formed gradually during tribal wars.
When 63. ________ strong tribe who highly respected snakes beat other tribes, they would mix the features of the losers' totem animals with their own 64. ________ (create) something truly powerful.
Guo Dashun, an archaeologist, said that the idea for a dragon 65. ________ (begin) to grow in northeastern China.
There, in Fuxin city, Liaoning province, archaeologists found in 1982 what appeared to be a dragon made up of granite 66. ________ (piece).
Dating back to 6000 BC, it is 67. ________ (old) artwork discovered that provides the image of a dragon.
In northeastern China, archaeologists also found many small jade dragons that date back to as early as 3500 BC.

"If you look really closely, they look 68. ________ ...a newborn be it a pig, a bear or a deer—which...curl up, until it's time to stretch their body," said TengShu-ping, a leading researcher from Taiwan who 69. ________ (study) ancient Chinese jade.
### --- PRINTED PAGE 37 ---
These jade dragons 70. ________ (imagine) by people whose society and art were still in the early stages, are "a reflection of a deep-felt amazement with the changing force of life," she said.
She believes this is what gives the Chinese dragon its "heartbeat".
filled_text: The year 2024 celebrates the Year of the Dragon.
Among the 12 animals of the Chinese zodiac, the dragon is the only one that is not real.
Though it looks scary, Chinese people respect it and even see themselves as the descendants of the dragon.
Wen Yiduo (1899-1946), a famous Chinese scholar and poet of his time, said that the image of a Chinese dragon formed gradually during tribal wars.
When a strong tribe who highly respected snakes beat other tribes, they would mix the features of the losers' totem animals with their own to create something truly powerful.
Guo Dashun, an archaeologist, said that the idea for a dragon began to grow in northeastern China.
There, in Fuxin city, Liaoning province, archaeologists found in 1982 what appeared to be a dragon made up of granite pieces.
Dating back to 6000 BC, it is the oldest artwork discovered that provides the image of a dragon.
In northeastern China, archaeologists also found many small jade dragons that date back to as early as 3500 BC.

"If you look really closely, they look like ...a newborn be it a pig, a bear or a deer—which...curl up, until it's time to stretch their body," said TengShu-ping, a leading researcher from Taiwan who studies ancient Chinese jade.
### --- PRINTED PAGE 37 ---
These jade dragons imagined by people whose society and art were still in the early stages, are "a reflection of a deep-felt amazement with the changing force of life," she said.
She believes this is what gives the Chinese dragon its "heartbeat".
filled_text_cn: 2024年是龙年。
在中国生肖的12种动物中，龙是唯一不真实存在的动物。
尽管它看起来很恐怖，中国人尊重它，甚至将自己视为龙的后代。
闻一多（1899-1946），他那个时代著名的中国学者和诗人，曾说过中国龙的形象是在部落战争中逐渐形成的。
当一个非常推崇蛇的强大部落击败其他部落时，这个部落会将敌人图腾动物的特征与自己的特征混合在一起，创造出真正强大的东西。
考古学家郭大顺说，龙的想法起源于中国东北地区。
在那里，辽宁省阜新市，考古学家在1982年发现了由花岗岩块制作成的龙形物品。
追溯到公元前6000年，它是目前发现最古老的龙图像艺术品。
在中国东北地区，考古学家还发现了许多可追溯到公元前3500年的小型玉龙。
“如果你仔细看，它们看起来像……新生儿——无论是猪、熊还是鹿……它们蜷缩着，直到伸展身体的时候，”来自台湾研究中国古代玉器的主要学者TengShu-ping说道。
### --- PRINTED PAGE 37 ---
她表示，这些玉龙是社会和艺术还处于早期阶段的人们想象出来的，是“对生命变化力量的深刻惊叹的反映”。
她相信这就是赋予中国龙“心跳”的原因。

questions.explanation: 空格后引导让步状语从句，表示“尽管”，可选 Though 或 Although（注：标准答案给出的首选为 Though 或 Although）。
questions.rule_summary: 让步状语从句常用 although 或 though 引导。

questions.explanation: see oneself as 表示“将自己视为……”，主语是 Chinese people，故用 they 的反身代词 themselves。
questions.rule_summary: 主宾指代同一人或物时用反身代词。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指一个强大的部落，strong 是辅音音素开头的单词，用不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且以辅音音素开头用 a。

questions.explanation: 此处用动词不定式作目的状语，表示“为了创造”。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式可作目的状语。

questions.explanation: 文章讲述过去的事情，叙述考古发现及观点，应用一般过去时，begin 的过去式为 began。
questions.rule_summary: 陈述过去发生的动作或状态用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: granite pieces 意为“花岗岩块”，此处用复数形式表示由多块花岗岩拼成。
questions.rule_summary: 表示多者或泛指时可数名词用复数。

questions.explanation: 根据范围“discovered that provides the image of a dragon”可知此处表示“最古老的”，应用形容词最高级，且其前需加定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 最高级前通常加 the，表示在一定范围内最……。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: look like 是固定搭配，意为“看起来像”。
questions.rule_summary: look like 表示“看起来像”。

questions.explanation: 定语从句中描述客观情况和人物身份特征，应用一般现在时，主语 a leading researcher 是单数，动词用第三人称单数 studies。
questions.rule_summary: 主语为单数第三人称时一般现在时动词加-s/es。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 主语 These jade dragons 与 imagine 之间是被动关系，且此处为描述过去人们的创造，应用一般过去时的被动语态（were + 过去分词）。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者时需用被动语态 (be done)。

filled_text: Once upon a time, there was no tea at all in England.
People there used to drink a light beer.
No coffee or milk but large glasses of beer stood on the breakfast table!
When tea was first brought to England, an old couple got some as a special treat.
But they did not know how it should be used.
They cooked the leaves in hot water, and spread them on a piece of bacon which they were going to have for dinner.
They ate the leaves, and threw the tea away!
However, tea is becoming as popular as coffee and milk in England today.
Tea is the leaf of a plant which grows widely in China, Japan and some other countries.
Tea farmers usually grow a great many tea plants on a large piece of land.
When the tea leaves are picked, it is the busiest time for tea farmers in a year.
They pull off the leaves and dry them.
In their spare time, they pick out the best leaves and get them ready for market.
In China, whenever a visitor comes into a house, he is served with a cup of tea.
filled_text_cn: 从前，英国根本没有茶。
那里的人过去常喝淡啤酒。
早餐桌上没有咖啡和牛奶，只有一大杯啤酒！
当茶第一次被带到英国时，一对老夫妇得到了一些作为特殊的款待。
但是他们不知道应该如何使用它。
他们把它们放在热水里煮，然后把它们涂在一块熏肉上，准备当晚饭吃。
他们把叶子吃掉了，把茶扔了！
然而，在今天的英国，茶正变得像咖啡和牛奶一样受欢迎。
茶是一种广泛生长在中国、日本和其他一些国家的植物的叶子。
茶农通常在一大片土地上种植大量的茶树。
采摘茶叶的时候，是茶农一年中最忙的时候。
他们把叶子扯下来晾干。
在业余时间，他们挑选最好的树叶，准备上市。
在中国，每当有客人进屋，都会被招待一杯茶。

questions.explanation: used to do sth.意为“过去常常做某事”，是固定搭配，故填动词不定式 to drink。
questions.rule_summary: used to do sth. 表示过去常常做某事。

questions.explanation: 根据句首“Once upon a time”可知，短文叙述过去的事情，时态为一般过去时，stand 的过去式为 stood。
questions.rule_summary: 通过时间状语Once upon a time判定用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意为“当茶第一次被带到 England 时”，表示“第一次”，应用 one 的序数词 first。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“第一”时，基数词one需变为序数词first。

questions.explanation: 上文提到他们得到了茶，下文说“他们不知道应该如何使用它”，前后构成转折关系，应用转折连词 But，位于句首首字母需大写。
questions.rule_summary: 前后分句存在语义转折时，用 but 连接。

questions.explanation: 根据后文的“spread them”可知，代词 them 指代复数名词，因此 leaf 需用其复数形式 leaves。
questions.rule_summary: 根据后文复数代词指代推断前文名词应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意为“茶正变得像咖啡和牛奶一样受欢迎”，as + 形容词原级 + as 是固定同级比较结构。
questions.rule_summary: as...as 表示“和……一样”，中间用形容词原级。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 grows 应用副词形式，wide 的副词是 widely“广泛地”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词，形容词加-ly变为副词。

questions.explanation: 主语 the tea leaves 与动词 pick 之间是被动关系，且根据“it is”可知应用一般现在时的被动语态，主语为复数，故填 are picked。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者时，谓语动词用被动语态（be done）。

questions.explanation: dry 是动词，其后跟人称代词作宾语，应用宾格形式 them。
questions.rule_summary: 动词或介词后面的人称代词用宾格形式。

questions.explanation: 定冠词 the 后面修饰名词时，表示三者或以上范围的“最好”，应用 good 的最高级 best。
questions.rule_summary: 定冠词 the 后常接形容词或副词的最高级形式。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (九)
raw_text: Confucius was a wise man in ancient China.
He is such 81. ________ great thinker that many people still know about him and his ideas.
# --- PRINTED PAGE 38 ---
"Ren" was considered to be the 82. ________ (important) among Confucius' ideas.
This special word means being kind and caring about 83. ________ happens in the world.
Confucius also talked about "Li", which means knowing the way to act 84. ________ (proper) in different situations.
Confucius started a school 85. ________ (spread) his ideas and thoughts.
He believed that everyone, whether rich or poor, should have a chance to learn.
This idea changed the way people thought about education.
The book, The Analects, records many of the things that Confucius said.
His students wrote 86. ________ (they) down so that other people could learn from him too.
In modern times, The Analects 87. ________ (use) almost every day by lots of people because it has wise advice that can help us in our lives.
One idea Confucius had about learning was that it never stops.
He said that if people wanted to get improvement, they should check themselves three 88. ________ (time) a day.
This is a very important idea, because the world is always changing and we need to keep up 89. ________ it.
Confucius' ideas 90. ________ (be) around in people's everyday lives since they appeared.

filled_text: Confucius was a wise man in ancient China.
He is such a great thinker that many people still know about him and his ideas.
# --- PRINTED PAGE 38 ---
"Ren" was considered to be the most important among Confucius' ideas.
This special word means being kind and caring about what happens in the world.
Confucius also talked about "Li", which means knowing the way to act properly in different situations.
Confucius started a school to spread his ideas and thoughts.
He believed that everyone, whether rich or poor, should have a chance to learn.
This idea changed the way people thought about education.
The book, The Analects, records many of the things that Confucius said.
His students wrote them down so that other people could learn from him too.
In modern times, The Analects is used almost every day by lots of people because it has wise advice that can help us in our lives.
One idea Confucius had about learning was that it never stops.
He said that if people wanted to get improvement, they should check themselves three times a day.
This is a very important idea, because the world is always changing and we need to keep up with it.
Confucius' ideas have been around in people's everyday lives since they appeared.
They become more and more popular in Western countries and South Asia.
filled_text_cn: 孔子是中国古代的一位智者。
他是如此伟大的思想家，以至于许多人仍然了解他和他的思想。
# --- PRINTED PAGE 38 ---
“仁”被认为是孔子思想中最重要的一个。
这个特殊的词意味着善良和关心世界上发生的事情。
孔子还谈到了“礼”，意思是知道在不同情况下如何正确行事。
孔子开办了一所学校来传播他的思想。
他相信每个人，无论贫穷还是富有，都应该有机会学习。
这个想法改变了人们对教育的看法。
《论语》这本书记录了孔子说的许多话。
他的学生把它们写下来，这样其他人也可以向他学习。
在现代，《论语》几乎每天都被很多人使用，因为它有明智的建议，可以帮助我们的生活。
孔子关于学习的一个观点是它永无止境。
他说，如果人们想取得进步，应该一天反省自己三次。
这是一个非常重要的想法，因为世界总是在变化，我们需要跟上它的步伐。
孔子的思想自从出现以来就一直存在于人们的日常生活中。
它们在西方国家和南亚变得越来越受欢迎。

questions.explanation: 句意：他是如此伟大的思想家，以至于许多人仍然了解他和他的思想。此处泛指一名伟大的思想家，应用不定冠词，great以辅音音素发音，故用a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指，辅音音素前用a，元音音素前用an。

questions.explanation: 句意：“仁”被认为是孔子思想中最重要的一个。根据among和空前面的定冠词the可看出，空白处应是形容词的最高级，故填important的最高级most important。
questions.rule_summary: 最高级：题前有the且句中有in/of表示范围时用最高级。

questions.explanation: 句意：这个特殊的词意味着善良和关心世界上发生的事情。根据“happens in the world”可知是一个宾语从句，此空白处填宾语从句引导词what，在后面的句子中充当主语的成分。
questions.rule_summary: 宾语从句中缺少主语或宾语且指代事物时用what。

questions.explanation: 句意：孔子还谈到了“礼”，意思是知道在不同情况下如何正确行事。根据act可知空格处缺少副词修饰动词，故填proper的副词properly，意为“适当地”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词（v.+adv.）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词不定式作目的状语
questions.explanation: 句意：孔子开办了一所学校来传播他的思想。根据“his ideas and thoughts.”可知，此处用动词不定式来表目的，spread的动词不定式为to spread。
questions.rule_summary: 不定式可作目的状语，意为“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 句意：他的学生把它们写下来，这样其他人也可以向他学习。wrote是动词，后跟they的宾格代词them作为宾语。
questions.rule_summary: 代词用在动词之后作宾语时，用其宾格形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 句意：在现代，《论语》几乎每天都被很多人使用，因为它有明智的建议，可以帮助我们的生活。根据“almost every day by lots of people”可知，此处是一般现在时的被动语态，主语The Analects是单数，因此be动词用is，use的过去分词为used。
questions.rule_summary: 被动语态结构为 be + done，根据主语单复数和时态确定be动词。

questions.explanation: 句意：他说如果人们想提高自己，就应该每天多次进行自我反省。由three可知，此处的time应该用复数times表示次数。
questions.rule_summary: 当所给词是单数可数名词时，且空前有2及以上数字修饰时，名词要用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：这是一个非常重要的想法，因为世界总是在变化，必须要做到与时俱进。keep up with是固定短语，意为“跟上”。
questions.rule_summary: 熟记常用动介搭配，如 keep up with（跟上）。

questions.explanation: 句意：孔子的思想从他们当时出现时起一直在影响着人们。根据“since they appeared.”可知，主句用现在完成时，主语是ideas（名词复数形式），因此助动词用have，be的过去分词为been。
questions.rule_summary: since引导的时间状语从句（一般过去时）常与主句的现在完成时连用。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (十)
raw_text: The traditional Chinese calendar divides the year into 24 solar terms.
Frost's Descent, the 18th solar term of the year, 91. ________ (begin) this year on Oct 23.
Frost's Descent is 92. ________ last solar term of autumn.
During this time, the weather becomes much 93. ________ (cold) than before and frost begins to appear.
In many parts of the country, 94. ________ (especial) in the north, there is a habit of eating persimmons 95. ________ the day of Frost's Descent.
The locals believe that eating persimmons can keep 96. ________ (they) away from a running nose in the winter and keep their lips from becoming dry.
In Daxin county, Guangxi, people celebrate the Frost's Descent Festival on the 97. ________ (one) day of Frost's Descent.
At the beginning, this activity was held by the Zhuang people 98. ________ (give) something back to nature 99. ________ also celebrate the harvest.
But later, it becomes a sacrifice to 100. ________ (hero).
On that day, the Zhuang people give sacrifices, dance and sing local songs.
filled_text: The traditional Chinese calendar divides the year into 24 solar terms.
Frost's Descent, the 18th solar term of the year, will begin this year on Oct 23.
Frost's Descent is the last solar term of autumn.
During this time, the weather becomes much colder than before and frost begins to appear.
In many parts of the country, especially in the north, there is a habit of eating persimmons on the day of Frost's Descent.
The locals believe that eating persimmons can keep them away from a running nose in the winter and keep their lips from becoming dry.
In Daxin county, Guangxi, people celebrate the Frost's Descent Festival on the first day of Frost's Descent.
At the beginning, this activity was held by the Zhuang people to give something back to nature and also celebrate the harvest.
But later, it becomes a sacrifice to heroes.
On that day, the Zhuang people give sacrifices, dance and sing local songs.
filled_text_cn: 中国传统历法将一年分为24个节气。
霜降是一年中的第18个节气，将于今年10月23日开始。
霜降是秋天的最后一个节气。
在这段时间里，天气变得比以前冷得多，霜冻开始出现。
在这个国家的许多地方，特别是在北方，人们有在霜降那天吃柿子的习惯。
当地人认为，吃柿子可以让他们在冬天远离流鼻涕，也可以防止嘴唇变干。
在广西大新县，人们在霜降节的第一天庆祝霜降节。
起初，这项活动是壮族人民举办的，目的是回馈大自然，庆祝丰收。
但后来，它变成了对英雄的祭献。
在那一天，壮族人民献祭、跳舞并唱当地的歌曲。

questions.explanation: 根据“this year on Oct 23.”可知，这里是一般将来时，需用will+动词原形，begin的原形为begin。故填 will begin。
questions.rule_summary: 根据时间状语和上下文语境确定正确的谓语动词时态。

questions.explanation: 根据“last solar term of autumn,”可知，这里特指最后一个节气，序数词前用定冠词 the。故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 序数词或表示特指时通常用定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: much 修饰比较级，cold 的比较级为 colder。故填 colder。
questions.rule_summary: much、even、far 等词常修饰形容词或副词的比较级。

questions.explanation: 根据“in the north,”可知，这里用副词修饰介词短语，especial 的副词形式为 especially。故填 especially。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰形容词、副词、动词或整个句子。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 根据“the day of Frost's Descent.”可知，具体到某一天时应用介词 on。故填 on。
questions.rule_summary: 具体到某一天或某一天的早中晚时，介词用 on。

questions.explanation: keep 是动词，后跟宾格代词作宾语，they 的宾格代词为 them。故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 动词或介词后面的代词通常用宾格形式。

questions.explanation: 定冠词 the 后跟序数词，one 的序数词为 first。故填 first。
questions.rule_summary: 表示顺序或“第几个”时，基数词需变为序数词。

questions.explanation: 根据“something back to nature”可知，这里用动词不定式作目的状语，give 的动词不定式为 to give。故填 to give。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式（to do）常用来作目的状语，表示“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 根据“something back to nature”和“also celebrate the harvest.”之间是并列关系，因此用 and 连接。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 并列连词 and 用于连接两个平行的成分，表示顺承或并列关系。

questions.explanation: 结合语境分析，此处泛指对英雄的祭献，应用复数形式，hero 的复数为 heroes。故填 heroes。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词在表示泛指或复数概念时，需变为复数形式。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (十一)
raw_text: Chinese buyers used to prize foreign brands.
They thought products made by American or European companies were of 101. ________ quality than Chinese ones.
Increasingly, that's no longer the case.
"Chinese people born before 1985 102. ________ think that foreign brands are better than Chinese ones," the billionaire William Li told Business Insider during a recent interview on CCTV-9.
"However, for those who were born 103. ________ 1985, it is a different picture."
"When I went to the United Kingdom for the 104. ________ time in 1997, I thought that the difference between China and Europe was quite big," Li said.
105. ________ for those born in the 1990s, when they visit Europe or the US, they do not think there is a big difference.
The change in thinking among Chinese buyers is showing up in many 106. ________ in China where western companies used to control.
107. ________ study found that young Chinese buyers are increasingly showing a 'home brand bias'.
More than 90% of young Chinese buyers would like 108. ________ home brands, according to the study.
Meanwhile, home companies which produce food, drinks, or personal care products increased 109. ________ share of the market by 3.3% over the last ten years to nearly 70%.
Chinese buyers, especially the younger ones, don't just believe that foreign brands are better.
They think China is good and "Made in China" is not bad at all.
So far, home companies 110. ________ the Chinese smartphone market.
Some foreign brands in the top ten have lost large ground to the home brands in recent years.
filled_text: Chinese buyers used to prize foreign brands.
They thought products made by American or European companies were of higher quality than Chinese ones.
Increasingly, that's no longer the case.
"Chinese people born before 1985 generally think that foreign brands are better than Chinese ones," the billionaire William Li told Business Insider during a recent interview on CCTV-9.
"However, for those who were born after 1985, it is a different picture."
"When I went to the United Kingdom for the first time in 1997, I thought that the difference between China and Europe was quite big," Li said.
But for those born in the 1990s, when they visit Europe or the US, they do not think there is a big difference.
The change in thinking among Chinese buyers is showing up in many markets in China where western companies used to control.
A study found that young Chinese buyers are increasingly showing a 'home brand bias'.
More than 90% of young Chinese buyers would like to buy home brands, according to the study.
Meanwhile, home companies which produce food, drinks, or personal care products increased their share of the market by 3.3% over the last ten years to nearly 70%.
Chinese buyers, especially the younger ones, don't just believe that foreign brands are better.
They think China is good and "Made in China" is not bad at all.
So far, home companies have controlled the Chinese smartphone market.
Some foreign brands in the top ten have lost large ground to the home brands in recent years.
filled_text_cn: 中国买家过去曾推崇外国品牌。
他们认为美国或欧洲公司生产的产品比中国的质量更高。
越来越多的时候，情况已不再如此。
亿万富翁李斌在CCTV-9最近的一次采访中告诉《商业内幕》：“1985年以前出生的中国人普遍认为外国品牌比中国品牌更好。”
“然而，对于那些在1985年之后出生的人来说，情况就不一样了。”
李斌说：“当我1997年第一次去英国时，我认为中国和欧洲的差异很大。”
但对于那些出生在20世纪90年代的人来说，当他们访问欧洲或美国时，他们认为没有太大区别。
中国买家思维方式的转变正出现在中国许多市场，而这些市场以往都是由西方公司控制的。
一项研究发现，中国年轻买家越来越表现出“本土品牌偏好”。
根据这项研究，超过90%的中国年轻买家想要购买本土品牌。
与此同时，生产食品、饮料或个人护理产品的本土公司在过去十年中的市场份额增加了3.3%，达到近70%。
中国买家，特别是年轻买家，并不认为外国品牌就一定更好。
他们认为中国很好，“中国制造”也一点不差。
到目前为止，国内企业已经控制了中国智能手机市场。
近年来，排名前十的一些外国品牌在本土品牌面前失去了大量市场份额。

questions.explanation: 根据空格后的“than”可知此处应用形容词比较级，用 higher 修饰名词 quality。
questions.rule_summary: 题后有 than 时用比较级。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词 think，应用副词形式 generally，意为“普遍地”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词。

questions.explanation: 根据上文“born before 1985”以及转折连词“However”可知，此处指1985年“之后”出生的人，用 after。
questions.rule_summary: 根据上下文语境及转折关系选择正确介词。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 for the first time 意为“第一次”，应用序数词 first。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 for the first time 中用序数词 first。

questions.explanation: 句意表示“但对于那些出生在20世纪90年代的人来说……”，与前文构成转折关系，用 But 连接（句首首字母大写）。
questions.rule_summary: 表示前后语义转折时用 but。

questions.explanation: many 后接可数名词复数形式，market 的复数形式为 markets。
questions.rule_summary: many 后接可数名词复数。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一项研究”，且 study 以辅音音素开头，应用不定冠词 A。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且以辅音音素开头时用 a。

questions.explanation: 固定搭配 would like to do sth. 意为“想要做某事”，应用不定式 to buy。
questions.rule_summary: would like 后面常接带 to 的动词不定式。

questions.explanation: 空后是名词 share，应用形容词性物主代词 their 修饰名词。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词应用形容词性物主代词。

questions.explanation: 根据句首的时间标志词“So far（到目前为止）”可知，句子应用现在完成时 (have/has done)；主语 home companies 是复数，助动词用 have。
questions.rule_summary: 看到 so far 常联想到现在完成时。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (十二)
raw_text: I have lived in this coastal city for more than twenty years.
111. ________ the past twenty years, great changes have taken place.
First of all, the city has become much 112. ________ (clean) than before.
There used to be rubbish in many places in the city.
The rivers that run through the city used to be dirty and smelly.
There 113. ________ (be) no fish swimming in the black water.
Thanks to the "civilized city" campaign, the quality of the city people 114. ________ (improve), so has the sense of protecting the environment.
Now, you can hardly see people litter about.
From morning till night you can see cleaners are busy working 115. ________ (keep) the city clean.
Secondly, the whole city has taken on a new look.
The city government set up the Shell Theater in the year of 2016 and now it has become 116. ________ symbol of this city.
Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge was open to traffic on Oct. 25th of 2018 and it connects three cities.
It is much more convenient for the local people and 117. ________ (tour) to travel by land instead of by sea.
All the roads in this city have been rebuilt and widened.
Besides, the old town has been repainted and decorated so that it 118. ________ look shabby any more.
Last but not least, the economy of this city has increased 119. ________ (rapid).
With the help of the high-speed trains, this coastal city has greatly improved 120. ________ (it) ability to attract more investment.
Without doubt, the future of this city will be brighter.
filled_text: I have lived in this coastal city for more than twenty years.
Over the past twenty years, great changes have taken place.
First of all, the city has become much cleaner than before.
There used to be rubbish in many places in the city.
The rivers that run through the city used to be dirty and smelly.
There were no fish swimming in the black water.
Thanks to the "civilized city" campaign, the quality of the city people has improved, so has the sense of protecting the environment.
Now, you can hardly see people litter about.
From morning till night you can see cleaners are busy working to keep the city clean.
Secondly, the whole city has taken on a new look.
The city government set up the Shell Theater in the year of 2016 and now it has become a symbol of this city.
Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge was open to traffic on Oct. 25th of 2018 and it connects three cities.
It is much more convenient for the local people and tourists to travel by land instead of by sea.
All the roads in this city have been rebuilt and widened.
Besides, the old town has been repainted and decorated so that it doesn't look shabby any more.
Last but not least, the economy of this city has increased rapidly.
With the help of the high-speed trains, this coastal city has greatly improved its ability to attract more investment.
Without doubt, the future of this city will be brighter.
filled_text_cn: 我在这个海滨城市生活了二十多年。
在过去的20年里，发生了巨大的变化。
首先，这个城市比以前干净多了。
这个城市的许多地方过去都有垃圾。
穿城而过的河流过去又脏又臭。
黑水里没有鱼在游动。
多亏了“文明城市”运动，市民的素质提高了，保护环境的意识也增强了。
现在，你很难看到人们乱扔垃圾。
从早到晚，你可以看到清洁工们忙着保持城市清洁。
其次，整个城市焕然一新。
市政府于2016年建立了贝壳剧院，现在它已成为这座城市的象征。
港珠澳大桥于2018年10月25日通车，连接了三座城市。
对于当地人和游客来说，走陆路而不是走海路要方便得多。
这个城市的所有道路都已重建和拓宽。
此外，老城区经过了重新粉刷和装饰，看起来不再破旧了。
最后但并非最不重要的是，这座城市的经济增长迅速。
在高铁的帮助下，这座海滨城市吸引更多投资的能力大大提高了。
毫无疑问，这座城市的未来会更加光明。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: over the past+一段时间意为“在过去的一段时间”，常与现在完成时连用，位于句首时首字母大写，故填 Over。
questions.rule_summary: over the past+段时间常用于现在完成时表示“在过去的一段时间里”。

questions.explanation: 根据句中的“than”可知，此处应用形容词的比较级形式，clean 的比较级为 cleaner。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现 than 时，形容词或副词通常用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 根据前文“used to be”可知本段描述过去的情况，时态为一般过去时。主语是“no fish”，fish 单复数同形，此处表复数含义，因此 be 动词用 were。
questions.rule_summary: 根据上下文时态及主语单复数确定一般过去时的 be 动词形式。

questions.explanation: 根据语境“Thanks to the 'civilized city' campaign”可知，人民的素质已经得到了提高，强调对现在的影响，应用现在完成时（has/have done）。主语“the quality”是不可数名词，助动词用 has。
questions.rule_summary: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，且主语为第三人称单数时，用 has done。

questions.explanation: 句意：从早到晚，你可以看到清洁工忙着工作是为了保持城市清洁。此处用动词不定式作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式（to do）常在句中作目的状语，表示“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“这座城市的象征”，且 symbol 是以辅音音素开头的可数名词单数，应用不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且首字母发辅音音素时，用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 根据并列的“local people”可知，此处指当地人和游客，应用名词复数形式 tourists。
questions.rule_summary: 当名词表示泛指类别或与复数概念并列时，可数名词应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句子描述一般客观情况，时态为一般现在时；动词原形 look 前需要助动词构成否定，主语 it 是第三人称单数，故用 doesn't。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时中，行为动词的否定句借助 don't / doesn't，第三人称单数用 doesn't。

questions.explanation: 此处需要用副词修饰动词 increased，rapid 的副词形式为 rapidly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或其他副词。

questions.explanation: 空后是名词 ability，应用形容词性物主代词其修饰，it 的形容词性物主代词是 its。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时用形容词性物主代词（如 its, my, your 等）。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (十三)
raw_text: Many people might think that if they had more money, then they would be happier in life.
For example, people might look at what others have, 121. ________ expensive clothes or nice cars, and wish they could have the same.
But the things that money can buy cannot bring happiness to a person for long.
But is that really true?
122. ________ (study) have found that money can, in fact, make people happy.
But it's not receiving money that brings happiness.
Instead, it is giving money to others that makes people happy.
It could be buying 123. ________ present for a friend or family member.
It could be buying a homeless person food to eat.
It could be giving money to a person in need.
Just think about the last time you used your own money 124. ________ (do) something for someone else.
How did you feel?
Whether it is a small or large amount of money, people feel happier when they give.
This is 125. ________ making someone else happy makes the giver happy, too.
This idea of connecting 126. ________ (you) happiness to the happiness of others is described as ubuntu in an 127. ________ (Africa) language.
There is even a story about a man visiting Africa who asked some kids to race to a nearby tree.
The 128. ________ (one) child to touch the tree would get a sweet treat.
Surprisingly, all the children 129. ________ (hold) hands and ran together.
They all touched the tree at the same time.
The man asked why they had done this.
The children 130. ________ (simple) said they could only enjoy eating the treat if everyone had one.
Clearly, those children understood that the key to happiness is making others happy.
filled_text: Many people might think that if they had more money, then they would be happier in life.
For example, people might look at what others have, like expensive clothes or nice cars, and wish they could have the same.
But the things that money can buy cannot bring happiness to a person for long.
But is that really true?
Studies have found that money can, in fact, make people happy.
But it's not receiving money that brings happiness.
Instead, it is giving money to others that makes people happy.
It could be buying a present for a friend or family member.
It could be buying a homeless person food to eat.
It could be giving money to a person in need.
Just think about the last time you used your own money to do something for someone else.
How did you feel?
Whether it is a small or large amount of money, people feel happier when they give.
This is because making someone else happy makes the giver happy, too.
This idea of connecting your happiness to the happiness of others is described as ubuntu in an African language.
There is even a story about a man visiting Africa who asked some kids to race to a nearby tree.
The first child to touch the tree would get a sweet treat.
Surprisingly, all the children held hands and ran together.
They all touched the tree at the same time.
The man asked why they had done this.
The children simply said they could only enjoy eating the treat if everyone had one.
Clearly, those children understood that the key to happiness is making others happy.
filled_text_cn: 许多人可能会认为，如果他们有更多的钱，他们在生活中就会更快乐。
例如，人们可能会看到别人拥有的东西，比如昂贵的衣服或漂亮的汽车，并希望他们也能拥有。
但是金钱能买到的东西并不能给一个人带来长久的幸福。
但事实真的如此吗？
研究发现，金钱实际上可以让人更快乐。
但带来幸福的并不是收到钱。
相反，把钱给别人才会让人快乐。
这可能是给朋友或家人买礼物。
这可能是给无家可归的人买食物吃。
这可能是把钱给需要帮助的人。
想想你最后一次用自己的钱为别人做点什么。
你当时感觉怎么样？
无论是数量少还是多的钱，人们在付出时都会感到更快乐。
这是因为让别人快乐，给予者也会感到快乐。
这种将自己的幸福与他人的幸福结合在一起的想法在非洲语言中被称为“乌班图”。
甚至还有一个故事，讲的是一个去非洲访问的男人让一些孩子比赛跑到附近的一棵树旁。
第一个摸到树的孩子会得到一份甜点。
令人惊讶的是，所有的孩子都手拉着手一起跑。
他们同时摸到了树。
男人问他们为什么要这么做。
孩子们只是说，只有当每个人都有一个时，他们才能享受吃糖果的乐趣。
显然，这些孩子明白，幸福的关键是让别人快乐。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 根据句意可知此处是在举例说明，like用作介词时，意为“比如”，故填like。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“例如、像……一样”时，常用介词 like。

questions.explanation: study用作名词时，意为“研究”，是可数名词，根据后面谓语动词have found可知主语应为复数形式，且位于句首，首字母需大写，故填Studies。
questions.rule_summary: 作主语的可数名词根据谓语动词的复数形式要变为对应的复数形式。

questions.explanation: present意为“礼物”，是可数名词，此处表泛指，且以辅音音素开头，应用不定冠词a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，辅音音素前用不定冠词 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 根据used your own money...something for someone else可知考查固定搭配use sth. to do sth.“使用某物做某事”，故填to do。
questions.rule_summary: use sth. to do sth. 表示“使用某物做某事”，不定式作目的或宾补。

questions.explanation: 根据“This is...making someone else happy makes the giver happy, too.”可知，后句是前句的原因，应用because引导表语从句。
questions.rule_summary: 解释原因时，表语从句通常由 because 引导。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 空后有名词happiness，应用形容词性物主代词修饰，you的形容词性物主代词为your。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时需用形容词性物主代词。

questions.explanation: 空后是名词language，应用形容词修饰，Africa的形容词形式为African“非洲的”。
questions.rule_summary: 名词修饰名词或作定语时，常需转换为相应的形容词形式。

questions.explanation: 根据“The...child to touch the tree”可知，此处表示“第一”，应用序数词first。
questions.rule_summary: 表示顺序时，基数词需转换为序数词，且通常前加定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: 根据句中并列谓语“ran together”可知句子时态为一般过去时，hold的过去式为held。
questions.rule_summary: 在讲述过去的故事时，动作发生在过去，谓语动词应用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 此处应用副词修饰动词said，simple的副词形式为simply“仅仅，只是”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词时，形容词通常变作对应的副词形式。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (十四)
raw_text: The Horse-Face Skirt
Have you heard of the horse-face skirt?
This Chinese skirt dates back to the Song Dynasty (960-1279).
The skirt has folds on both 131. ________ (side).
The two smooth panels in the front overlap each other, and so do the two smooth panels in the back.
These overlaps leave openings in the front and back of the skirt.
In 2022, French fashion brand Dior 132. ________ (copy) the design of the skirt.
Many hanfu lovers began to spread the knowledge of the skirt.
This helped more people learn about 133. ________ (tradition) Chinese clothes.
"For us, wearing the skirt is not just for fashion," said Mao, one of the hanfu lovers.
"It also shows our love for Chinese culture."
Mao said 134. ________ (proud).
Recently, more attention 135. ________ (give) to the skirt.
Many famous Chinese people have worn it to international events.
136. ________ during this past Spring Festival, lots of young people wore the skirt when they went on trips.
People in other countries like this skirt, too.
Chinese clothing companies have gotten a lot of orders for it from abroad.
137. ________ report studied how popular the skirt was among foreign users of Chinese short video platforms.
What did the report find?
Last year, users from more than 90 countries and regions shared content about the skirt!
This is a good example of Chinese culture going global.
And it is also a good way 138. ________ (spread) Chinese culture.
Besides the skirt, "new Chinese-style clothes" is also a hot topic.

filled_text: The Horse-Face Skirt
Have you heard of the horse-face skirt?
This Chinese skirt dates back to the Song Dynasty (960-1279).
The skirt has folds on both sides.
The two smooth panels in the front overlap each other, and so do the two smooth panels in the back.
These overlaps leave openings in the front and back of the skirt.
In 2022, French fashion brand Dior copied the design of the skirt.
Many hanfu lovers began to spread the knowledge of the skirt.
This helped more people learn about traditional Chinese clothes.
"For us, wearing the skirt is not just for fashion," said Mao, one of the hanfu lovers.
"It also shows our love for Chinese culture."
Mao said proudly.
Recently, more attention was given to the skirt.
Many famous Chinese people have worn it to international events.
And during this past Spring Festival, lots of young people wore the skirt when they went on trips.
People in other countries like this skirt, too.
Chinese clothing companies have gotten a lot of orders for it from abroad.
A report studied how popular the skirt was among foreign users of Chinese short video platforms.
What did the report find?
Last year, users from more than 90 countries and regions shared content about the skirt!
This is a good example of Chinese culture going global.
And it is also a good way to spread Chinese culture.
Besides the skirt, "new Chinese-style clothes" is also a hot topic.
These clothes add traditional Chinese elements to modern designs.
They have won the hearts of many.
All this shows that we are becoming much more confident in our own culture.
filled_text_cn: 马面裙
你听说过马面裙吗？
这条中国裙子可以追溯到宋代（960-1279年）。
裙子两边都有褶皱。
前面的两个光面饰片相互交叠，后面的两个光面饰片也是如此。
这些交叠在裙子的前后留出了开口。
2022年，法国时尚品牌迪奥模仿了这种裙子的设计。
许多汉服爱好者开始传播这种裙子的知识。
这帮助更多的人了解了中国传统服装。
“对我们来说，穿这条裙子不仅仅是为了时尚，”汉服爱好者之一毛说。
“它也表达了我们对中国文化的热爱。”
毛骄傲地说。
最近，这种裙子受到了更多的关注。
许多中国名人曾穿着它出席国际活动。
在刚刚过去的春节期间，许多年轻人外出旅行时都穿着马面裙。
其他国家的人也很喜欢这条裙子。
中国服装企业已经收到了来自海外的大量订单。
一份报告研究了这种裙子在中国短视频平台的外国用户中的受欢迎程度。
这份报告发现了什么？
去年，来自90多个国家和地区的用户分享了关于这条裙子的内容！
这是中国文化走向世界的一个好例子。
这也是传播中国文化的好方法。
除了裙子，“新中式服装”也是一个热门话题。
这些服装为现代设计增添了中国传统元素。
它们赢得了许多人的心。
这一切表明，我们对自己的文化变得更加自信了。

questions.explanation: 句意：裙子两边都有褶皱。on both sides“两边”，为固定介词短语，故填 sides。
questions.rule_summary: both后面接可数名词复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：2022年，法国时尚品牌迪奥模仿了这种裙子的设计。根据时间状语“In 2022”可知，此句应用一般过去时态，动词copy的过去式为copied。
questions.rule_summary: 表示过去特定时间的动作用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意：这有助于更多的人了解中国传统服装。根据空后的“Chinese clothes”可知，空处应填一个形容词修饰名词。tradition是名词，其形容词形式为traditional。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词修饰名词作定语。

questions.explanation: 句意：“这也表明了我们对中国文化的热爱。”毛骄傲地说。根据空前的“Mao said...”可知，空处修饰动词“said”，应用副词形式proudly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词。

questions.explanation: 句意：最近，这种裙子受到了更多的关注。根据“Recently, more attention...to the skirt.”可知，主语more attention与give之间是被动关系，且发生在过去（recently常用于一般过去时或现在完成时，此处结合语境为一般过去时被动语态），故填was given。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者时用被动语态（be + done）。

questions.explanation: 句意：在刚刚过去的春节期间，许多年轻人外出旅行时都穿着马面裙。前句与空处的句子是顺承/递进关系，应用连词and，位于句首首字母需大写。
questions.rule_summary: 表示顺承或递进关系时用and。

questions.explanation: 句意：一份报告研究了这种裙子在中国短视频平台的外国用户中的受欢迎程度。此处泛指一份报告，空后的“report”为可数名词单数，且以辅音音素开头，所以用不定冠词A，位于句首首字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且以辅音音素开头时用a。

questions.explanation: 句意：这也是传播中国文化的好方法。way后面常用动词不定式作后置定语，故填to spread。
questions.rule_summary: the way to do sth. 表示“做某事的方法”。

questions.explanation: 句意：这些服装为现代设计增添了中国传统元素。add...to...为固定动词短语，意为“把……添加到……中”。
questions.rule_summary: add...to... 表示把……加到……中。

questions.explanation: 句意：这一切表明，我们对自己的文化变得更加自信了。空前有much修饰，应用形容词的比较级more confident。
questions.rule_summary: much可以修饰形容词或副词的比较级。

sections.title: 名校精准练 (十五)
raw_text: "Zero calories and no putting on weight."
We often talk about diet soft drinks like this.
But are they really a good 141. ________ (choose) for us?
Some people think diet soft drinks are 142. ________ (healthy) than others because they don't have sugar or calories.
In their opinion, having these drinks can help 143. ________ (they) lose weight.
Actually, diet soft drinks also have some sugar.
Usually, with 0.5 gram of sugar or less in 100-gram drink, this kind of drink 144. ________ (describe) as a diet soft drink.
145. ________ they have little sugar, diet soft drinks still taste sweet by using artificial sweeteners.
They have very few calories.
But when you eat sweet-tasting things like sugar, it hits your brain and 146. ________ (make) you want more.
Your brain tells your body 147. ________ (prepare) itself for more sugar.
When you drink 148. ________ bottle of diet soft drink, the brain receives the "sweet signal", but no sugar arrives.
Since the brain is fooled, it still wants more sweets.
Some people drink diet soft drinks instead 149. ________ water.
Diet soft drinks can damage your 150. ________ (tooth) and affect your appetite.

filled_text: "Zero calories and no putting on weight."
We often talk about diet soft drinks like this.
But are they really a good choice for us?
Some people think diet soft drinks are healthier than others because they don't have sugar or calories.
In their opinion, having these drinks can help them lose weight.
Actually, diet soft drinks also have some sugar.
Usually, with 0.5 gram of sugar or less in 100-gram drink, this kind of drink is described as a diet soft drink.
Although they have little sugar, diet soft drinks still taste sweet by using artificial sweeteners.
They have very few calories.
But when you eat sweet-tasting things like sugar, it hits your brain and makes you want more.
Your brain tells your body to prepare itself for more sugar.
When you drink a bottle of diet soft drink, the brain receives the "sweet signal", but no sugar arrives.
Since the brain is fooled, it still wants more sweets.
Some people drink diet soft drinks instead of water.
Diet soft drinks can damage your teeth and affect your appetite.
These drinks are not good for you.
filled_text_cn: “零卡路里且不会发胖。”
我们经常这样谈论低热量软饮料。
但它们对我们来说真的是一个好的选择吗？
有些人认为低热量软饮料比其他饮料更健康，因为它们没有糖或卡路里。
在他们看来，喝这些饮料可以帮助他们减肥。
事实上，低热量软饮料也含有一些糖分。
通常，在100克饮料中含0.5克或更少的糖，这种饮料就被描述为低热量软饮料。
尽管它们含糖很少，但低热量软饮料通过使用人工甜味剂尝起来仍然很甜。
它们的卡路里非常少。
但是当你吃像糖这样味道甜的东西时，它会刺激你的大脑，让你想要更多。
你的大脑告诉你的身体为更多的糖分做好准备。
当你喝一瓶低热量软饮料时，大脑接收到“甜味信号”，但没有糖到达。
由于大脑被愚弄了，它仍然想要更多的甜食。
有些人喝低热量软饮料而不是水。
低热量软饮料会损害你的牙齿并影响你的食欲。
这些饮料对你没有好处。

questions.explanation: 空前有不定冠词 a 和形容词 good 修饰，应用名词形式。choose 的名词形式为 choice，意为“选择”。
questions.rule_summary: 冠词或形容词后通常接名词，动词需转化为对应的名词形式。

questions.explanation: 句中含有标志词 than，表示两者的比较，应用形容词的比较级 healthier。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现 than 时，形容词/副词通常用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: help 为动词，其后常接人称代词的宾格形式作宾语，故 they 变为 them。
questions.rule_summary: 动词或介词后面的人称代词用宾格形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 主语 this kind of drink 与动词 describe 之间是被动关系（饮料被描述为……），且描述的是客观事实，应用一般现在时的被动语态 (is/am/are done)，主语是第三人称单数，故填 is described。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者且表达客观事实时，用一般现在时的被动语态。

questions.explanation: 前后分句“它们含糖很少”与“低热量软饮料尝起来仍然很甜”之间构成让步关系，应用 although 引导让步状语从句（句首首字母大写）。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“虽然、尽管”时，用 although 或 though 引导让步状语从句。

questions.explanation: 句型由 when 引导的时间状语从句和主句构成，主句描述客观规律，时态为一般现在时。主语是 it（代指前面提到的事情），谓语动词用第三人称单数 makes。
questions.rule_summary: 描述客观情况时用一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数时动词加 -s/-es。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 tell sb. to do sth.（告诉某人做某事），此处应用动词不定式作宾语补足语，故填 to prepare。
questions.rule_summary: tell sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“告诉某人做某事”。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 a bottle of（一瓶……），bottle 是可数名词单数且发音以辅音音素开头，故用不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指数量“一”或用于固定短语 a bottle of 中，辅音音素前用 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 固定短语 instead of，意为“而不是”，符合语境。
questions.rule_summary: instead of 是常用介词短语，意为“代替、而不是”。

questions.explanation: 人通常有多颗牙齿，这里泛指牙齿应用复数形式。tooth 的不规则复数形式为 teeth。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词泛指多者时通常用复数形式，注意不规则变化。
